description: This file defines the Subunit class, which extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable and ValueXModifiable interfaces. It manages filtering by organizational subunits in reports, providing methods to modify query builders, retrieve subunit IDs, convert to array representations, and modify X values based on the company structure.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Represents a filter field for organizational subunits in reporting modules, allowing inclusion/exclusion of subunits and conversion of subunit data for display or processing.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to filter employees based on selected subunits if the operator is 'IN' and X is set.

methods.name: getSubunitIds
methods.description: Returns an array of subunit IDs by splitting the comma-separated string in X.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in query contexts, defaulting to ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the stored X value into an array containing subunit id and label, retrieving data via the company structure service.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Modifies the X value by retrieving the subunit chain as a comma-separated string based on the current X.
